column1: # Game profile of Taiko Risshiden V DX (Switch, update v131072 = 1.1.1; Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese). Plays on the iPhone; on the Mac from the logos, the opening movie
# and the title through a new game (the 1560 scenario as Kinoshita Tokichiro: the story, the council, the main order, the territory map, a save and a load) and the field battle tutorial,
# at 60 fps with sound, about 0.7 GB resident and 1.6 GB of Metal allocations; in handheld mode by touch (taps, drags and swipes)
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL on NVN, SDK 12.3.3 (no other game's sdk build). Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: the WebM opening and ending movies) + sdk.
# RomFS: loose files, 3.3 GB: KTGL G1T textures (some in MRLK packs), the game's own TR5 / TE5 / TS5 data, KTSS Opus streams (.kno, through nn::codec) and KTSL wave banks (.wbd / .whd).
# The shaders are GLSLC outputs: 45 in main and 167 in the G2S container eff/KTGLEffect.g1s (_S2G3000, as Age of Calamity's); nothing is compiled at run time

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# handheld: the Switch build plays by touch there. It takes its taps, pans and swipes from nn::hid::GetGestureStates (main+0x42f1ac: tap a card or a button, drag the map), which the
# host recognizes from the touches (hle_touch.c gesture_sample): on the iPhone the touches no gamepad control takes, on the Mac the mouse. Docked it reads only the pads. It draws
# touch: the virtual gamepad starts in its Tap layout, every touch to the game (the pads' corners would cover the cards, the menu icons at the top right and the on-screen B button);
# its layout button brings back 2D / 3D (the map scrolls with the right stick; L / R and ZL / ZR switch tabs and lists)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − used memory (3.14 GB here), which the game maps only as it touches it. The 4 GB block
# of the other games without virtual address memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; the G2S container in eff/, GLSLC outputs in main) ----
